meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 要搜索或读取网页时，会改用 Exa 的服务：能按关键词或语义找网页，也能一次读取多个网址或论文 PDF，并更偏好学术来源。需要先配好 EXA_API_KEY。
howto.when: 当你说要搜索资料、获取网页或提取文章内容时触发。

say.text: 搜一下癌症免疫治疗的最新研究进展
say.note: 会以研究论文类别搜索，偏向学术来源
会通过Exa读取该网页并给出正文

say.text: 找找arXiv上关于大语言模型的论文
say.note: 会限制在学术网站白名单内检索

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude routes web searches and URL extraction through Exa: it can look up pages by keyword or semantic match, fetch multiple URLs or academic PDFs at once, and favors scholarly sources for technical questions. Requires an EXA_API_KEY to be set.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search the web, fetch a URL, or extract an article.

say_en.text: Search for recent advances in cancer immunotherapy
say_en.note: Uses Exa search with the research-paper category.

say_en.text: Extract the main text from https://example.com
say_en.note: Fetches the page through Exa and returns the content.

say_en.text: Find papers about large language models on arXiv
say_en.note: Restricts results to the academic domain allowlist.
